product.headline: A booking. A confirmation call. A clear record.
product.description: Customers book online. AI makes an outbound call to confirm the appointment. The owner sees the call record, and staff handle requests that need a person.

steps.label: Book online
steps.detail: The customer chooses an appointment through your booking page.

steps.label: Call to confirm
steps.detail: AI follows up with an outbound confirmation call.

steps.label: See the record
steps.detail: The owner can review the call outcome and transcript. Staff handle customer requests.

concepts.name: Monolith
concepts.headline: Give your customer your full attention.
concepts.description: While you are with a customer, others can book online. AI follows up with a confirmation call, and you can review the result.
concepts.alt: A precision product photograph of an ordinary black smartphone on a seamless graphite shelf, with restrained cool light and a dark architectural composition.
concepts.cameraMotion: A slow lateral move reveals the phone's edge. Cut cleanly to the booking, then the outbound call and the owner's record. The physical object stays familiar; the service is explained in readable interface text.

storyboard.label: A familiar object.
storyboard.detail: One measured camera move across the phone and graphite surface.

storyboard.label: Booked online.
storyboard.detail: A clean cut introduces a customer choosing an appointment.

storyboard.label: Called to confirm.
storyboard.detail: The appointment leads into a clearly identified outbound confirmation call.

storyboard.label: The outcome, recorded.
storyboard.detail: The call record settles into the owner's dashboard.

concepts.name: Architecture
concepts.headline: Step away from the desk.
concepts.description: Customers can choose an appointment online. AI calls to confirm, so the follow-up does not depend on you staying at the desk.
concepts.alt: A full-scale boutique reception atrium with white-metal architectural surfaces, a precise reception desk, cool natural light and generous empty space.
concepts.cameraMotion: Move slowly through the reception atrium toward the desk. Match its geometry to the online booking interface, then follow the outgoing call into the owner's dashboard. Keep the space full-scale and the movement deliberate.

storyboard.label: Space to arrive.
storyboard.detail: The camera enters a quiet, full-scale reception atrium.

storyboard.label: Booked online.
storyboard.detail: The desk's geometry gives way to a simple booking interface.

storyboard.label: Called to confirm.
storyboard.detail: An outbound call connects the appointment with the customer.

storyboard.label: The outcome, recorded.
storyboard.detail: The owner's dashboard presents the appointment and call record.

concepts.name: Interface
concepts.headline: Spend less time chasing confirmations.
concepts.description: AI calls to confirm online bookings. You can review the call record and handle any requests that need a person.
concepts.alt: A macro study of precisely aligned, separated smoked-glass software interface planes against a dark background, with clear spacing and subtle cool-white edge lighting.
concepts.cameraMotion: Track along the edges of four aligned interface planes. Move between booking, call, transcript and summary, then return to a straight-on dashboard. Keep every movement on a clear axis and every final label in real interface text.

storyboard.label: The booking.
storyboard.detail: A single appointment establishes the starting point.

storyboard.label: The structure.
storyboard.detail: Four software layers separate: booking, call, transcript and summary.

storyboard.label: Called to confirm.
storyboard.detail: The camera isolates the outbound confirmation call within the layers.

storyboard.label: The outcome, recorded.
storyboard.detail: The layers align into a readable dashboard and call record.

concepts.name: Evolution
concepts.headline: Take a break. Keep bookings moving.
concepts.description: Customers book online. AI calls to confirm. You see the outcome when you return.
concepts.alt: Three ordinary phones — a rotary desk phone, a push-button desk phone and a smartphone — arranged in a disciplined diagonal progression, photographed in graphite and titanium tones.
concepts.cameraMotion: Use disciplined match cuts across the three phones for the first 20% of the proposed sequence. Give the remaining 80% to online booking, the outbound AI confirmation call and the owner's record. Match position and lighting between devices; keep each device's form intact.

storyboard.label: The hardware evolved.
storyboard.detail: Three familiar phones, connected by precise match cuts. The opening occupies 20% of the proposed sequence.

storyboard.label: Booked online.
storyboard.detail: The smartphone introduces a customer selecting an appointment.

storyboard.label: Called to confirm.
storyboard.detail: AI makes the outbound confirmation call for that booking.

storyboard.label: The outcome, recorded.
storyboard.detail: The owner sees the call record. Staff handle requests that need a person.

opening.headline: Step away. Bookings keep moving.
opening.support: Your customers book online. AI calls them to confirm. You see the outcome.
opening.alt: A business owner taking a quiet coffee break on a coastal terrace, with a phone face down beside them and a wide view of the sea.

benefits.label: With a customer
benefits.detail: Give them your attention. Other customers can book online, with AI calling to confirm their appointments.

benefits.label: Away from the desk
benefits.detail: Step out without taking booking follow-up with you. Customers book online and AI makes the confirmation call.

benefits.label: Taking a break
benefits.detail: Enjoy a coffee or a little breathing room. Review the call outcome when you are ready.

benefits.label: Taking time off
benefits.detail: Customers can still book online. Your appointment and call records stay together for you to review.
